description: Source code for the 'git clean' builtin command, implementing cleaning and removal of untracked files and directories with interactive and pattern-based options.

methods.name: git_clean_config
methods.description: Handles configuration options for 'git clean', such as color settings and require-force flag.

methods.name: clean_get_color
methods.description: Returns the color code string for a given color type if color output is enabled.

methods.name: clean_print_color
methods.description: Prints the color code for a given color type.

methods.name: exclude_cb
methods.description: Callback to add patterns to the exclude list.

methods.name: remove_dirs
methods.description: Recursively removes directories and their contents, with options for dry run and quiet mode.

methods.name: pretty_print_dels
methods.description: Prints the list of files/directories marked for deletion in columns.

methods.name: pretty_print_menus
methods.description: Prints menu options in columns.

methods.name: prompt_help_cmd
methods.description: Displays help information for prompt-based selection.

methods.name: print_highlight_menu_stuff
methods.description: Displays menu items with highlighted hotkeys and selection status.

methods.name: find_unique
methods.description: Finds a menu item index based on a unique prefix or hotkey.

methods.name: parse_choice
methods.description: Parses user input for menu selection, supporting ranges and prefixes.

methods.name: list_and_choose
methods.description: Implements interactive menu for selecting files to delete, returning selected indices.

methods.name: clean_cmd
methods.description: Main command handler for 'git clean'.

methods.name: filter_by_patterns_cmd
methods.description: Allows user to input ignore patterns to filter files for deletion.

methods.name: select_by_numbers_cmd
methods.description: Allows user to select files to delete by number via interactive menu.

methods.name: ask_each_cmd
methods.description: Prompts user for confirmation before deleting each file.

methods.name: quit_cmd
methods.description: Exits the cleaning process.

methods.name: help_cmd
methods.description: Displays help information for 'git clean' commands.

methods.name: interactive_main_loop
methods.description: Runs the interactive command menu loop for cleaning.

methods.name: correct_untracked_entries
methods.description: Adjusts directory entries to exclude ignored files.

methods.name: cmd_clean
methods.description: Entry point for 'git clean' command, parsing options, preparing directory traversal, and executing cleaning.
